title: Remarks on the antimaximum principle
summary: We present several observations on the antimaximum principle (AMP) for the model problem $-Δ_p u = λ|u|^{p-2} u + f$ in a bounded smooth domain $Ω$, subject to the zero Dirichlet boundary conditions, and where the source function $f$ is nontrivial, nonnegative, and sufficiently regular. Denote by $λ_f$ the endpoint of validity of the AMP, so that every solution of the problem is negative in $Ω$ for any $λ\in (λ_1,λ_f)$.
